name: DropGaussian
definition: A regularization technique for sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting that randomly removes Gaussians during the training process to alleviate overfitting to training views.
summary: DropGaussian is a prior-free structural regularization technique for sparse-view Gaussian Splatting that mitigates overfitting by randomly dropping Gaussians and scaling remaining opacities without external data or added complexity.
